title: GTA6 Dev Rockstar HR Manager Testifies in Union Trial
description: Rockstar HR manager claims he had little interest in employee union evidence prior to layoffs in an ongoing legal trial.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar HR Manager Testifies as Union Trial Heats Up

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming title *GTA6*, the studio is currently navigating a legal battle involving labor relations. In the ongoing Rockstar Games vs Garland & Others case, fresh testimony has shed light on the events leading up to a substantial number of layoffs affecting union Discord members.

According to reports from Eurogamer, a witness in the trial—specifically a Rockstar HR manager—stated that he had "little interest" in evidence of unionisation efforts sent to him by an anonymous employee. This communication occurred prior to the developer laying off a significant portion of the union's Discord community members.

## Context and Industry Implications

The trial centers around accusations of union-busting following the mass layoffs at the studio. While the HR manager downplayed his engagement with the anonymous tip regarding unionization, the broader case highlights ongoing tensions within the video game industry regarding worker representation and corporate response.

For a studio currently under intense global scrutiny as it develops *GTA6*, navigating these internal labor disputes remains a critical challenge. The outcome of the trial could set important precedents for how major game developers handle employee organization and workplace communications moving forward.

## Editor's Take

Legal battles and labor controversies are never ideal for a studio in the home stretch of a blockbuster release like *GTA6*. While this trial focuses on past employment practices, it underscores the growing friction between corporate management and game developers advocating for better workplace rights in the modern gaming industry.
